name: ck23yx-tracker-reminders
goal: Prove a journaled Tracker reminder disappears from the decision digest and status tick, reappears at its timestamp and sends one durable notification across restart and signed sync.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: CLI and synthetic hub/spoke must preserve the decision and due date, hide the item from flagged status input and digest until the UTC instant, and wake the latest active reminder once through durable delivery. Red: native remind unavailable; direct notification leaked before wake; webhook had no scheduled delivery.
